    // ---- CSV load ----
    window.__almLimitLoad = function (rows) {
      if (!rows || rows.length < 1) return;
      var lines = [];
      rows.forEach(function (r) {
        var te = parseFloat(r.yi !== undefined ? r.yi : (r.effect !== undefined ? r.effect : (r.TE !== undefined ? r.TE : r.te)));
        var se = parseFloat(r.sei !== undefined ? r.sei : (r.SE !== undefined ? r.SE : (r.seTE !== undefined ? r.seTE : r.se)));
        if (!Number.isFinite(te) || !Number.isFinite(se) || se <= 0) return;
        var label = r.study || r.label || r.Study || '';
        lines.push(te.toString() + ', ' + se.toString() + (label ? ', ' + label : ''));
      });
      if (lines.length < 1) return;
      document.getElementById('src').value = lines.join('\n');
      run();
    };
